note: The Eastern Caribbean Economic Union's free movement of persons (Revised Treaty of Basseterre; OECS Authority decision of May 2011): citizens of the Protocol Member States (Antigua and Barbuda, Dominica, Grenada, St Kitts and Nevis, Saint Lucia, St Vincent and the Grenadines, Montserrat) live in any other indefinitely, with an indefinite stay stamp on arrival, and work there without a work permit (OECS Commission, 16 January 2024). A state keeping this list keeps it before the csme one, so its citizens' freedom counts over the CARICOM Skills Certificate. The list gives no rule for other passports.

sources.title: OECS Commission, OECS Continues to Strengthen the Free Movement of Persons Regime (16 January 2024)
sources.said: Indefinite Stay : OECS citizens can live in any Protocol Member State indefinitely receiving an indefinite stay stamp upon arrival. ... No Work Permit : OECS citizens and their third-country spouses can work in any Protocol Member State without obtaining a work permit. ... stakeholder consultations were held in Antigua and Barbuda, the Commonwealth of Dominica, Grenada, St. Kitts and Nevis, Saint Lucia and Saint Vincent and the Grenadines. The engagements will be finalised in January 2024 following discussions with senior officials from Montserrat.
